basic_info.description: The homes at 541 29th Street offer spacious living in one of the city’s most comfortable neighborhoods. Built in 2001 these condominiums feature open-floor plans with large island kitchens, gas fireplaces, spacious master suites, multiple outdoor spaces and 1-car garage parking each.
